instruction: Post a question about the last t-shirt I ordered on amazon, "Has anyone experienced the color fade after the first wash?".
notes: Single-app task (amazon). The agent gets the amazon password, logs in, lists past orders (newest first), inspects the most recent order containing a t-shirt to get the product id, confirms the product_type via show_product, then posts the question with write_product_question. The target product/order objects are runtime placeholders resolved by iterating orders newest-first until one contains a product with product_type == "t-shirt"; static init facts (in-order, has-type) encode that selection. The goal demands exactly one new ProductQuestion on that product with the given text; supervisor.complete_task takes the posted product/question as task-record parameters (no answer, since the task is not a question) and is forced last via (not (task-completed)) on all other actions.
